text:
Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — Sam Park submitted a two-week notice yesterday. Last official day is Fri 2024-06-14. Need to coordinate benefits/COBRA timing, access removal, and laptop return. Assigning owners below.

Anika (Engineering Manager): Confirmed on my end. Sam is handing over the AI-serving rollout docs this week. Can we schedule exit interview + final benefits walk-through on Wed 06/12?

Sam Park: Yep, 06/12 works for me in the afternoon. I can share a short handoff doc and list of active creds.

OffboardBot: Created ticket OFF-7892 for Sam Park offboarding. Checklist populated and assigned — people-ops (Priya), IT (Mateo), Security, Benefits Team. Reminder: auto-email to Sam in 24h with next steps.

Mateo (IT): Mateo here — need laptop model + serial and whether Sam has any external devices (a monitor dongle, YubiKey). Also confirm if laptop needs encrypted backup before pickup.

Sam Park: MacBook Pro M1, serial C02X1234XYZ. I have a YubiKey and one external USB-C dongle. No extra drives.

Mateo (IT): Got it. Scheduling courier pickup for Mon 06/17 (first business day after termination) unless you prefer drop-off earlier. Will wipe and image after asset return.

Security Team: Recommend deprovisioning critical access on last working day (06/14) at 6pm PT: AWS, GitHub org, PagerDuty, Okta sessions. Please confirm any exceptions. Also remove personal SSH keys from build hosts.

Anika (Engineering Manager): For CI service accounts we need at least 48h to rotate tokens. Can Security hold escrow for the release window and rotate on 06/14 18:00 PT?

Security Team: Yes — we'll schedule token rotation at 18:00 PT on 06/14 and remove personal access tokens immediately after. Please list any repos that need a transfer instead of deletion.

Priya (People Ops): COBRA/benefits notes: Termination date is 06/14. Health/dental/vision coverages terminate at the end of the month by default (06/30) unless the company elects a different runout. Benefits Team — please confirm when COBRA packet will be sent and the 60-day enrollment window start date.

Benefits Team: Confirmed — COBRA election window opens the day after termination notice is processed. Official packet will be emailed within 7 business days after the termination date (so by ~06/21). Employee has 60 days from the packet date to elect COBRA. We'll also include COBRA cost estimates and KFF contact info.

Priya (People Ops): Action items summary (informal checklist):
```
- People Ops: schedule exit interview (06/12) + send final benefits packet notice.
- Manager: confirm handoff doc + owner for each active project.
- IT: schedule pickup, wipe, and ensure backup of work data.
- Security: deprovision AWS/GitHub/PagerDuty/Okta on last day at 18:00 PT.
- Benefits: email COBRA packet within 7 business days.
```

Priya (People Ops): Extra notes: Sam has a personal fork in the infra repo — Anika, please add a company owner or transfer to team before 06/14. Also ask Sam to remove any personal tokens from third-party services (Sentry, DataDog) by EOD 06/13.

Anika (Engineering Manager): Will take repo transfers today. Sam, please DM me the list of third-party scopes to confirm before EOD.

Sam Park: Will send the list in DM now. Thanks everyone for being quick with this.

Mateo (IT): One more thing — if Sam needs CAE (company admin encryption) key escrow for any local dev VMs, ping me; otherwise we'll preserve work directories for 30 days then securely delete.

Benefits Team: Also offering a 15-minute call with a benefits specialist during the COBRA decision window if Sam wants to review costs. Priya, can you flag that in the packet?

Priya (People Ops): Done — will include the 15-min consult link and Benefits Team contact in the packet. I'll also create a calendar invite for the exit interview on 06/12 at 2pm PT and tag this thread with the OFF-7892 ticket.

OffboardBot: OFF-7892 updated: exit interview scheduled 2024-06-12 14:00 PT; IT pickup scheduled 2024-06-17; deprovision time set 2024-06-14 18:00 PT. All assignees notified.

Security Team: Noted. We'll also run a privileged access review for Sam's accounts and archive any active sessions at deprovision time.

Anika (Engineering Manager): Thanks. If anything blocks the rollout handoff, I'll escalate. Otherwise this looks good.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks team — I'll post a final confirmed timeline here once OFF-7892 is locked. :white_check_mark:
